stem.archstudio.timeline_baseline: This is the earliest retained state. It may already contain blocks.
stem.archstudio.timeline_unchanged: No block properties changed in this step.
stem.archstudio.timeline_changed_help: Changed means shape, material, color, or rotation at the same cell. Moving a block counts as removal and addition.
stem.archstudio.timeline_scope_help: Counts and changes include all blocks at this step, including those hidden by 3D filters. Project names and notes are not compared.
stem.archstudio.timeline_history_help: Replay contains up to 50 undo states plus the latest build. Leaving replay preserves the live build and undo history.
stem.archstudio.timeline_display_help: Viewport and heatmap show this historical step. Analysis, wind, badges, and totals describe the live build.
